subject: Post-call SLO confirmation & customer-led load test deliverables
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T18:55:00Z
Subject: Recap and next steps — SLOs & customer-led load test

Hi Samir — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the concrete asks we agreed on so we can get your customer-led load test scheduled: 

1) SLO targets you confirmed on the call
   - p50 latency (text generation): <= 60 ms
   - p95 latency: <= 350 ms
   - sustained throughput target: 2500 tokens/sec overall (approx 80 concurrent short requests)
   - peak concurrency target (burst): ~400 concurrent requests for 1–2 minute spikes
   - streaming sessions: support 200 simultaneous streaming sessions (chunked responses) with <=150ms first-byte

2) Test scope we agreed
   - End-to-end inference: route through Redwood hosted environment using the same model config you plan to use in prod (r-instruct-large-quant)
   - Mix: 70% short generations (<=64 tokens), 30% streaming long responses (>=512 tokens)

3) Deliverables for the customer-led run (what we need from Finlytics)
   - k6 script (or Locust) for the traffic mix. If you want, we can provide a k6 starter script — Marissa can share our template.
   - Test accounts: one test API key scoped to a sandbox project + example payloads
   - IPs to allowlist (we will provide Redwood egress IPs)
   - Desired test window (2–4 hour window for sustained run + one 30m peak-burst rehearsal)

Action items I took away:
- Soojin: facilitate firewall/allowlist exchange and schedule a 30-minute dry run with Ben (SRE) and your infra lead.
- Marissa: attach k6 starter and example payloads to this thread.
- Samir: confirm test window and provide the name/email of your infra/security contact so we can share allowlist details securely.

Attachments: I will attach our k6 starter and a sample allowlist CSV once Marissa uploads them.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap and next steps — SLOs & customer-led load test

Thanks Soojin — that layout matches what we discussed. Quick answers from our side: 

- Test window: prefer Tue 2026-11-16 02:00–06:00 UTC for sustained run (low production traffic for us) with a 30-minute peak rehearsal at 03:30 UTC. If that doesn't work for Redwood, we can do Wed 2026-11-17 same window.
- Infra/security contact: Alex Gomez (alex.gomez@finlytics.com). He will handle allowlisting and VPN details.
- We will try to reuse our existing k6 harness but would appreciate Redwood's starter to compare ramp profiles.

Two notes: 
- We will run the load from our own k6 runners hosted in AWS us-east-1 (we won't be using Redwood-initiated runners).
- We need the test API key and allowlist IPs at least 48 hours before the window.

Please loop Alex on the allowlist communication. Also, can you confirm the maximum sustained QPS per Redwood instance so Alex can size the load generators?

Samir
Director, Platform Engineering
Finlytics
samir@finlytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finlytics.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T13:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap and next steps — SLOs & customer-led load test

Alex / team — looping in SRE details. Short answers and what we'll provide: 

- Sustained QPS guidance: a single Redwood serving pod (r-heavy-32g) pegs around 80–100 short requests/sec (64-token median) for the model you referenced. For your sustained target of ~80 concurrent short requests we estimate 2–3 pods to keep p95 within target with modest batching enabled.
- IP allowlist: attaching the file (finlytics-test-ips.csv) with our egress ranges you should allow. Please confirm if you need CIDR or single IPs; we can provide both.
- Test API key: we'll create a sandbox API key scoped to your Finlytics account and place credentials in the secure vault. For handoff we'll provide a short-lived GPG-encrypted blob; if your infra prefers, we can upload to your SFTP.
- Observability hooks: we will enable a temporary 7-day retention trace and token-level cost logs for the test. Send any special tracing IDs you want injected.

Attachments: finlytics-test-ips.csv, test-account-readme.txt (credential handoff instructions).

Prep suggestion for k6 runners (since you're running from AWS): ramp to steady-state over 15 minutes, sustain 2 hours, then a 30-minute burst at +250% RPS to validate spike behavior. Use the sample payloads Marissa will share so batching and token counts match our expectations.

Ben Carter
SRE — Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finlytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T16:12:00Z
Subject: Confirmed: Tue 2026-11-16 02:00–06:00 UTC (dry run Mon 2026-11-15 22:00 UTC) + attachments

Thanks all — locking in the timeline per Samir/Ben's notes. Summary of what you'll receive from Redwood by EOD 2026-11-10: 
- k6 starter harness (k6-finlytics-read-heavy.js) with the traffic mix and payloads (Marissa)
- allowlist CSV (finlytics-test-ips.csv) and instructions for firewall rules (Ben)
- sandbox API key handoff instructions (Ben)
- a brief runbook for the dry run and the full run (1–2 page PDF)

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Alex: confirm that the Tue 2026-11-16 02:00–06:00 UTC window works and ack receipt of allowlist CSV (by 2026-11-10 18:00 UTC).
- Ben: create the sandbox API key and share secure handoff method (by 2026-11-10 18:00 UTC).
- Marissa: attach k6 script and sample payloads to this thread (done — see attachments).
- Soojin: schedule a 30-min dry-run coordination call Mon 2026-11-15 22:00 UTC; invite list will be Alex, Samir, Ben, Marissa, and Soojin.

If anything changes to the SLO targets we captured earlier, flag it here — otherwise we'll proceed with the plan.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

-- Attachments referenced in thread --
1) k6-scripts/v2/k6-finlytics-read-heavy.js (JS k6 script, 18 KB stub)
2) allowlist/finlytics-test-ips.csv (CSV, 12 lines)
3) test-accounts/finlytics-k6-credential-stub.txt (hand-off instructions, encrypt/transfer steps)
